notes:
the only avian & exotic hospital in Nassau; serves all of NYC (Manhattan, Queens, Brooklyn, Bronx, Staten Island) plus Westchester/NJ/CT. Treats birds, reptiles, parrots, sugar gliders, rabbits, chinchillas and other small mammals; offers endoscopy, anesthesia, minimally invasive surgery, emergency services, MEDICAL BOARDING and grooming (birdexoticsvet.com). A strong exotics-only option for outer-borough/LI residents.

333 Great Neck Road, Great Neck, NY 11021, in Nassau County, just over the Queens line. Not a 24-hour hospital: in opening hours call the main line; from 9pm to midnight call the after-hours line and the on-call doctor calls back, and if nobody has called back within 15 minutes go to a 24-hour emergency hospital. From midnight to 9am, go straight to a 24-hour emergency hospital.
